verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a self-service transfer for moving existing CRM data in, plus multi-object imports covering records and activities like calls and meetings, with associations between them. The API also supports syncing records from other systems, and dedup by email/domain or record ID helps keep migrated data clean. Missing for 10: any evidence that record owners are preserved or mapped during migration, detail on how full history (emails, notes, timelines) carries over from a source CRM, and independent or hands-on corroboration of migration fidelity.
